cause_quote: The new request-auth resolver called `assertCurrent();` before `await getApiKeyForModelCore({`, so a peer's pending refresh threw before credential resolution could wait for it.
user_saw: An agent run failed with “MCP authorization state is temporarily unavailable” when its next model request overlapped another run's refresh of the same OAuth profile.
summary: Request authentication now waits within the credential deadline for a peer's OAuth refresh and looks up credentials again if the refresh overlapped the first lookup.
reasoning: The parent already had an OAuth manager that waited for pending refreshes, and the authorization code at #184791 already threw when the selected credential was pending. #184791 introduced per-request OAuth resolution with that throwing check ahead of the lookup, so the failure existed from the first version of the request-auth path. The later deadline refactor carried the same check forward when it inlined the resolver.
